items.author: Matt Norlander
items.body_excerpt:
LSU wins today's battle (as do dozens of players seeking a win who aren't trying to play at LSU). 

But the issue is far from over. The SEC filed a federal lawsuit on Thursday against LSU. If Lane Kiffin opts to play even one guy who the SEC deems ineligible, the retroactive penalties will be huge.
